issues.exact_original_acceptance_section:
## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Generate POM and Gradle module metadata on two different hosts and compare dependency selectors
- Resolve and launch a desktop WebView consumer on Linux x64, macOS arm64/x64 and Windows x64
- Verify native classifier availability for every advertised architecture
issues.title: [High][BUILD-001] Desktop WebView POM hard-codes the publisher OS in JavaFX dependencies

issues.exact_original_acceptance_section:
## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Test empty, irrelevant-file-only, wrong-platform, corrupt, stale-revision and missing-library directories
- Verify full artifact manifests before assembling candidate desktop JARs
- Load each candidate binary and check JNI symbol compatibility on its intended host
issues.title: [High][BUILD-003] Any nonempty prebuilt native subdirectory suppresses every local native build

issues.exact_original_acceptance_section:
## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Verify per-module test counts are nonzero where expected
- Exercise all regressions listed in module finding required_tests
- Build isolated minimum-supported-SDK and Kotlin/Compose-version consumers
- Assert Kotlin/JNI/Swift API compatibility against the retained compatibility surface
issues.title: [High][BUILD-006] Verification pipeline does not gate platform behavior, consumer compatibility, or native correctness

issues.exact_original_acceptance_section:
## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Assert required resource paths against the documented supported-platform matrix
- Run JNI load and dialog cancellation tests on real Linux arm64 and Windows arm64 if claiming support
- Verify glibc/SDK minimum compatibility of produced binaries
issues.title: [Medium][BUILD-004] Packaged native platform matrix omits Linux arm64 and Windows arm64 paths expected by loaders

issues.exact_original_acceptance_section:
## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Reject an intentionally modified downloaded build artifact in a local verification fixture
- Check frozen JS/Python dependency installation from empty caches
- Validate action SHA updates and least-privilege workflow permissions
- Re-run full resolved-graph security scans after dependency updates
issues.title: [Medium][BUILD-007] Dependency and workflow trust is not reproducibly verified beyond the wrapper
